avoid_dishes.dish: Dishes with oyster or hoisin sauce

name: MiMi Mei Fair
questions: Do you have gluten-free (tamari) soy sauce for cooking and for the table, or only for dipping?
Is the hot and sour soup thickened with cornstarch or with wheat starch?
Which dishes on the GF menu, if you have one, use oyster or hoisin sauce?
Can GF dishes be cooked in a cleaned wok?

safe_dishes.note: Named by an FMGF reviewer as GF. Confirm it isn't thickened with wheat starch or made with regular soy sauce.

summary: The best-reviewed GF Chinese option I found on FMGF: a reviewer called it 'a really great option for gluten-free Chinese' and GF soy sauce is reported, but the reviews are undated and FMGF contradicts itself on whether there's a formal GF menu.
tamari_source: Find Me Gluten Free (FMGF) lists soy sauce among its reported GF items (crowd-sourced, undated). One FMGF page says it has a GF menu and another says it doesn't.
